description: Single source of truth for Strongroom HTTP security headers (derived from /docs/PRD.md Sections 8 and 9). Mirrored in render.yaml and enforced by backend/src/middleware.

commonHeaders.Permissions-Policy: accelerometer=(), camera=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()

clientContentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://api.strongroom.example; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; require-trusted-types-for 'script'
